name: ONNX (Open Neural Network Exchange)
summary: Open standard format (IR plus operator sets) for representing ML models as computation graphs, with a reference Python library (checker, shape inference, reference evaluator), so models move between frameworks, runtimes and hardware.

name: FATE (Federated AI Technology Enabler)
summary: Industrial federated learning framework for cross-institution collaboration on data, with secure computation protocols based on homomorphic encryption and multi-party computation, horizontal and vertical FL algorithms, and private set intersection.

name: Unity Catalog
summary: Open multimodal catalog and governance layer for tables, files, functions and ML models, with an OpenAPI spec, multi-engine access, and an MLflow-compatible registry of registered models and model versions.

name: OpenLineage
summary: Open standard (OpenAPI spec plus client libraries and integrations for Spark, Airflow, dbt, Flink) for emitting run, job and dataset lineage metadata events, extensible through facets; Marquez is the reference collector.

name: Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS)
summary: YAML specification (with JSON Schema) for data contracts between producers and consumers: fundamentals, schema, data-quality rules, purpose/usage/limitations, terms and licence references, roles, team, SLA, pricing and infrastructure.

name: Egeria
summary: Open metadata and governance platform: an open metadata type system, APIs, event payloads and cohort-based interchange protocols that let tools and organisations exchange and federate metadata, lineage, licences and governance definitions.

name: Monocle
summary: OpenTelemetry-based tracing for GenAI apps and agents (LLM calls, agent turns, tool invocations, retrieval) plus monocle-test-tools, a pytest framework that asserts on recorded traces: agent invocation and delegation, tool inputs/outputs, response similarity, cost/latency/error states, and simulated-user scenario tests.
